title: Smoky Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired fish dish, slow-cooked in a smoky tagine sauce.

ingredients.name: fish
ingredients.notes: any firm white fish, such as cod or snapper

instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper.
In a large tagine or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the smoky tagine and marinated, stirring to combine.
Add the fish to the tagine, skin side up.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the yogurt and lemon juice.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
